sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to services reported using the 1500 Health Insurance Claim Form (a/k/a CMS-1500), UB04 claim form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form. This policy applies to all products, all network and non-network physicians and other qualified health care professionals, outpatient facility claims, Ambulatory Surgical Centers (ASC), Outpatient Surgical Centers (OSC), including, but not limited to, non-network authorized and percent of charge contract physicians, other qualified health care professionals or facilities.

children.title: United Healthcare Commercial
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all UnitedHealthcare Commercial benefit plans.

children.title: UnitedHealthcare Individual Exchange
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all Individual Exchange benefit plans.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for biomarker testing associated with autoimmune rheumatic disease.

sections.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.

Antinuclear Antibodies and Extractable Nuclear Antigen UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of antinuclear antibodies (ANA) and extractable nuclear antigen (ENA) testing procedure codes for a general encounter without abnormal findings.
Cell-Bound Complement Activation UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following procedure code for the use of cell-bound complement activation products (e.g., Avise Lupus).

Diagnostic Testing UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of serum biomarker panel testing with proprietary algorithms and index scores for the diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus or connective tissue diseases when submitted for the conditions of systemic lupus erythematosus or connective tissue disease.
